description: Logical projects agent-fabric manages. A working copy is matched to a project by its origin remote (or a .agent-fabric-project marker at its toplevel), never by its directory name. Paths here are repository-relative; machine-specific checkout locations live in each agent's runtime binding. `memory` is where the project's distilled knowledge lives INSIDE the project's working copy (fabric-coordinator's to write; every role reads it). `license` is the SPDX identifier the project's OWN tree carries — information about the project, not about anything here: this repository is Apache-2.0 throughout, projects/<id>/ included. `legacy_clone_bindings` (optional) names, relative to the project's working copy, that project's record of the directory-bound clones it once had — under its .agent-fabric/, since it is the project's data — which the GitHub tooling (runtime/github/) consults to tell an heir from an orphan on older branch prefixes.
